quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Electronics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Director and general manager Zhang Gongjing (results briefing): Q1 2026 revenue was RMB 24.11 hundred million, up 53% year on year, and net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 4.45 hundred million, up 122%; in 2026 the company will focus on structural growth in high-end markets and the AI compute wave.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue RMB 24.11 hundred million (+53%); net profit RMB 4.45 hundred million (+122%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Electronics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Results briefing: general manager Zhang Gongjing said the Dongcheng plant (phase four) 5G high-speed high-density PCB expansion is producing HDI, optical-module and rigid-flex boards at scale with output and output value up sharply; the Thailand plant had its main building topped out by December 31, 2025 and enters equipment debugging and trial production in 2026; the intelligent computing center project's phase 1 trial production in 2025 met its output-value target. Chairman Deng Chunhua said the company has completed development of a satellite-communications product series and reached small-batch mass production, with output expected to rise gradually in 2026, and that it has entered the core PCB supply chain for key components of leading customers, bringing AI server, OAM and UBB high-end products into large-scale mass production.
